## Requirements (contract)

1. **D1 baseline reconciliation** — record the actual P31.19 tip and compare every DESIGN
   (`docs/build/planning/2026-09-25-six-streams/DESIGN.md` § "Existing P31 ownership and the delta")
   ownership row to landed code, tests, hosted and public evidence; append any scope reductions before
   dispatching consumers.
2. **D2 strict parser + discrepancy report** — read-only parser for manifest, ledger, deferrals,
   coverage and ADR supersessions; malformed/duplicate obligation ids, OPEN-first/DONE-later conflicts
   and legacy filename forward dependencies detected by adversarial fixtures; **no control-state writes**.
3. **D3 named funnel + evidence domains** — publish named source funnel and evidence-domain
   definitions; route D-P31.1-1/D-P31.1-3 and the unresolved P31 flags explicitly rather than losing
   them in the new round.
4. **D4 execution baseline** — use the imported P31.19 closeout + the integration receipt as the
   baseline: reconcile the appended ACCEPT-R8 correction (signed at `0a715fc`), the exact CI
   head/evidence, and the dated source-research limitations; preserve the already-signed approval;
   confirm the D-P31.1-3 → P32.2, D-P31.1-1 → P32.4, D-P31.5-2 → P32.5 closure contracts before
   dispatch (without closing the rows).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Malformed/duplicate obligation ids, OPEN-first/DONE-later conflicts and legacy filename forward
  dependencies are detected by adversarial fixtures.
- [ ] No existing human gate or deferral is closed by parsing; baseline inventory names dates, domains,
  evidence refs and all unresolved delta decisions.
- [ ] Verification green; meaningful tests that fail if removed; requirement ids stamped in the PR;
  owned DEFERRALS rows for non-automatically-verifiable items; ADRs for new deviations/decisions;
  authorized closeout protocol (ledger/BUILD_INDEX/runs/pr).

## Plan

1. Branch off `c8d72cc`; confirm baseline `make check` green.
2. `docs/build/tools/audit_current_state.py` — a stdlib-only, read-only strict parser producing a
   structured discrepancy report (check / severity / file / obligation / evidence + input SHA-256
   digests; JSON + Markdown to **caller-provided** paths, never a shared `/tmp` file). Checks:
   manifest chain grammar/duplicates/file↔row agreement, forward `Depends on:` resolved against
   **manifest order** (so legacy-named tickets can't hide forward deps behind sequence 0), LEDGER
   CURRENT-STATE key order + nextTicket/lastCompleted + PHASE-LOG coverage, DEFERRALS id
   grammar/duplicates/status enum/missing BL home/status-conflict (owed-leading status vs later dated
   terminal claim), COVERAGE_MATRIX vs canonical spec ids (dynamic count, not hardcoded),
   ADR file/index/Appendix-F agreement + dangling references.
3. `tests/unit/test_build_memory_audit.py` — adversarial fixture trees (tmp_path) proving every defect
   class is detected, plus the real-tree run asserting the four known status-conflict rows and zero
   errors; read-only digest assertion.
4. `docs/build/reports/p32.1-baseline/RECONCILIATION.md` — the baseline inventory: actual tips/heads,
   DESIGN ownership-row reconciliation vs landed code/tests/hosted/public evidence, discrepancy-report
   findings, stale-doc conflict inventory, unresolved delta decisions, and the explicit routing of every
   unresolved P31 flag; plus `discrepancies.{json,md}` emitted by the tool on the real tree.
5. `docs/build/reports/p32.1-baseline/EVIDENCE_DOMAINS_AND_SOURCE_FUNNEL.md` — the named source-funnel
   units and evidence-domain definitions for downstream consumers (P32.7 projection, P32.21 funnel).
6. DEFERRALS routing annotations (append-only, no status flips) on the three engineering rows and the
   four mechanical status-conflict rows; dated addendum appended to `DESIGN.md` recording the confirmed
   baseline + the narrowed D-P31.5-2 delta.
7. Verify (make check, docs-check, memory/backlog/coverage/plan tools), commit, stacked PR on
   `codex/round10-seed-after-p31-19`, then the authorized closeout (LEDGER + PHASE LOG + BUILD_INDEX
   row 161 + runs/pr).
